title: Sign encoding of the binary inner product
statement: For any natural number $n$ and vectors $x,y\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, evaluate the Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $2n$ at the sign encoding of the concatenation of $x$ and $y$. The result is the sign encoding of their inner product modulo two.
